title: Embryo Transfer With Self-spent Culture Medium
brief_summary: Embryo Transfer With Self-spent Culture Medium or new Culture Medium in Vitro Fertilization - Embryo Transfer Process, to analyze which way can improve clinical pregnancy outcomes, is there a significant difference between the two?
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infertility female patients with tubal factors,
* Infertile female patients with spouse factors

Exclusion Criteria:

* Intrauterine adhesions,
* Endometriosis,
* Primary ovarian insufficiency，
* Infectious disease
